# MouseChanged

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseChanged:Int32
```

**Returns:** True if the mouse was used, False if not or if there is no such mouse.

## Description

Tells if the user did anything with a mouse since the last time this was asked, which is handy to find out what to play with.
Asking clears the answer. Plugging in a new mouse counts as using it once.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If MouseChanged() Then Text 10, 10, "The mouse was used"
	Flip
Wend
```
